verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's own docs say payment plans let developers set up customer subscriptions, and its payment links support recurring payments, so the core of plan-based recurring billing exists. Nothing in the evidence addresses trials, plan upgrades or downgrades, or proration, and the subscription support rests on a single thin docs line. Missing for 10: free trial support, plan upgrade/downgrade flows, proration handling, in-depth subscription API docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Payment plans let you set up subscriptions for your customers on Flutterwave.
Receive one-off or recurring payments from anyone, anywhere, via your unique payment link.
